memory_definition: PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX sampled every 10 ms and once after exit; PeakWorkingSetSize and PeakPagefileUsage are OS-maintained peak working-set and process-commit counters. PrivateUsage is a sampled maximum, not a guaranteed peak. The record states whether the after-exit query succeeded.
limits: Cold-process wall time includes JIT, initialization and output. Rounded console dispersion times are descriptive only.
Five interleaved repeats provide local evidence, not a production-domain speed guarantee.
Fixed RNG seeds do not guarantee parallel accumulation order. Parallel repeat variation is measured.
All inputs are synthetic. The latest baseline already contains merged PRs 59, 60, 61 and 65.
